summary:
bash: # Step 2: Set ACLs on /srv/shared
# First, clear any existing ACLs
setfacl -b /srv/shared

# Set current ACLs:
# - group research: rwx
# - user alice: rwx
# - user bob: rwx
# - other: ---
# - mask: rwx (to allow all named entries)
setfacl -m g:research:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -m u:alice:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -m u:bob:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -m o::--- /srv/shared
setfacl -m m::rwx /srv/shared

# Set default ACLs (for inheritance):
# - default group research: rwx
# - default user alice: rwx
# - default user bob: rwx
# - default other: ---
# - default mask: rwx
setfacl -d -m g:research:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m u:alice:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m u:bob:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m o::--- /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m m::rwx /srv/shared

echo "ACLs set successfully"
